item.title: [+1] India-US trade deal in final stage with the bulk of issues sorted, foreign minister says
item.description:
He said remaining concerns are mostly on the American side. The commerce minister has said the first tranche is finalised and in legal drafting, to take effect once India's tariff edge over rivals is assured. Progressing from Friday.

Pharma & healthcare: mild tailwind (+1) — US market access

Why it matters: A signed first tranche would lock in lower US tariffs than competitors face, helping textiles, engineering goods and pharma exporters and supporting foreign-investor sentiment.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Foreign investor flows +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1, Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
